decision_reason: Direct union of successful judge issues.

issues.issue: Inconsistent horizontal padding between text and CTA.
issues.evidence: The left margin of the product title 'Pro Wireless Headset' is narrower than the left margin of the 'Add to Cart' button, creating a slight misalignment in the vertical axis of the left edge.
issues.probable_cause: Different padding or margin values applied to the text container versus the button container.

issues.issue: Imbalanced vertical padding in the content area.
issues.evidence: The whitespace between the blue header and the product title is visibly larger than the whitespace between the 'Add to Cart' button and the bottom edge of the card.
issues.probable_cause: Uneven padding distribution (top vs bottom) within the white card body.

issues.issue: Visual hierarchy conflict between category and product identity.
issues.evidence: The category label 'HEADPHONES' in the blue header is visually more aggressive (all-caps, high-contrast background, larger scale) than the actual product name 'Pro Wireless Headset', which may distract the user from the primary product identity.
issues.probable_cause: Over-emphasis of the image placeholder/category styling over the product detail typography.

issues.evidence: The card has a title and price, but no star ratings or review counts.
issues.probable_cause: The rating component was left out of the design.

issues.issue: The product image is just a blue block with text.
issues.evidence: The top section says 'HEADPHONES' on a blue background instead of showing an actual picture of the headset.
issues.probable_cause: A real product image hasn't been uploaded yet, and the placeholder is too generic.
